Roblox reincorporated from Delaware to Nevada on May 30, 2025. LEADER: David Baszucki, co-founder, President and CEO. The proxy states 100% of Class B and 58.8% of total voting power (Class A marked * for less than 1%), not a percentage of all shares, so pctEconomic is null and the computed figure is in leader.derived. His Class B shares are held through trusts: The Freedom Revocable Trust (he is trustee), the 2020 Jan Baszucki Gift Trust (he exercises control) and the 2020 David Baszucki Gift Trust (his spouse exercises control). Class B fell from 48,293,658 to 47,070,464 shares over the year. Director Gregory Baszucki (12,078,807 Class A, 1.8%) is listed separately in the proxy and is not added. HOLDERS: largestHolders is null, not empty.
